    AI Overview
    As of April 12, 2026, Rory McIlroy’s career earnings have surpassed $114 million on the PGA Tour alone, making him second only to Tiger Woods. His 2026 Masters win, which included a $4.5 million prize, brought his total to approximately $114.69 million. His total earnings are significantly higher when including European Tour (DP World Tour) earnings, bonuses, and endorsements. 
    Career Earnings Highlights (As of April 2026) 
    • Total PGA Tour Earnings: ~$114.7 million.
    • 2026 Masters Payout: $4.5 million.
    • 2025 Masters Payout: $4.2 million.
    • All-time Ranking: Second behind Tiger Woods (who has over $120 million). 
    Factors Boosting Earnings 
    • FedEx Cup Bonuses: He has earned tens of millions from FedEx Cup success, including three titles.
    • Player Impact Program (PIP): He has garnered significant bonuses from the PGA Tour’s PIP, collecting $35 million in the first four years of its existence.
    • DP World Tour: He has secured over €60 million ($68M+) on the DP World Tour (formerly European Tour).
    • Endorsements: His earnings are significantly supplemented by major partnerships, including a long-term deal with Nike. 
    Note: Earnings figures in golf can vary slightly between sources due to the timing of updates, currency fluctuations, and whether they include official tournament payouts, bonuses, or international earnings.
